components:area-chart.title: Area Chart
components:area-chart.description: A single-series volume chart with a zero baseline, direct axes, one-time reveal, keyboard inspection, crosshair, and bounded paper tooltip.

components:bar-chart.title: Bar Chart
components:bar-chart.description: The canonical horizontal category comparison with direct labels, shared D3 scales, zero-baseline reveal, and keyboard-accessible tooltips.

components:donut-chart.title: Donut Chart
components:donut-chart.description: A restrained part-to-whole chart with a visible total, persistent legend, named data colors, and hover or keyboard inspection.

components:heatmap-matrix.title: Heatmap Matrix
components:heatmap-matrix.description: A responsive labeled matrix for cohorts and repeated patterns with D3 band scales, intensity mapping, two-axis keyboard navigation, and cell tooltips.

components:histogram-chart.title: Histogram
components:histogram-chart.description: A true value-distribution chart with D3 bins, readable frequency axes, bottom-up reveal, generous hit regions, keyboard inspection, and bounded paper tooltips.

components:line-chart.title: Line Chart
components:line-chart.description: A multi-series time comparison with direct axes, an external legend, one-time path drawing, shared crosshair, and keyboard-accessible tooltips.

components:radar-chart.title: Five-Axis Radar Chart
components:radar-chart.description: The opinionated pentagonal profile chart: exactly five directly labeled measures, D3 geometry, one profile polygon, keyboard or hover inspection, paper tooltip, and reduced-motion-safe reveal.

components:scatter-plot.title: Scatter Plot
components:scatter-plot.description: A two-measure relationship plot with optional magnitude encoding, explicit axes, generous hit targets, focus inspection, and paper tooltips.

components:stacked-bar-chart.title: Stacked Bar Chart
components:stacked-bar-chart.description: A composition-over-time comparison with shared D3 scales, persistent series legend, bottom-up segment reveal, group inspection, and keyboard-accessible paper tooltips.

components:segmented-bar.title: Segmented Bar
components:segmented-bar.description: The compact part-to-whole treatment with one fixed height, named data colors, a persistent legend, and hover or keyboard inspection.

components:sparkline.title: Sparkline
components:sparkline.description: The inline trend treatment with D3 curve geometry, a one-time draw, crosshair, compact tooltip, and keyboard inspection.
